headline: THE EVIDENCE GATE HAS COLLAPSED AND FAILS IN BOTH DIRECTIONS - zero categories short (three at 23:00), one at most long. For the first time since the gate began passing, L-001 is NOT the only thing standing between this experiment and a trade. All three scheduled events landed and all three resolved: the 12:00Z 4h bar CLOSED at 2682.25, 16.05 points ABOVE the 2666.20 threshold; ETHUSDT funding UNCLAMPED for the first time in the experiment (+0.009626%); and BNBUSDT's 4h artifact bar DID NOT age out, its flag vanishing instead because the window's MEDIAN ROSE - a fourth distinct mechanism in four checks.

event_a_4h_close.finding: At 22:00 and 23:00 the bar read BELOW the threshold and was moving AWAY from it; ETH then rallied 2659 -> 2682.25 in the bar's final 56 minutes and closed 16.05 points ABOVE. Reading the bar early at either check would have given the OPPOSITE ANSWER. Strongest vindication of L-006's forming-bar rule in the experiment.
event_a_4h_close.consequence: trend NO LONGER CLAIMABLE SHORT. 4h lows 2666.20 -> 2669.37 -> 2633.31 -> 2640.00 is a HIGHER LOW; 4h closes 2684.16 -> 2675.48 -> 2692.23 -> 2647.90 -> 2682.25 recovered. Not claimable long either: daily closes still falling, 4h highs capped under 2698.06.

event_b_funding_settlement.why_not_claimed: +0.009626% is only 3.7% below the cap, ETH's OI is FLAT at +0.017%, BTC's own rate COLLAPSED from +0.002958% to +0.000186% at the same settlement, and three of five contracts are still pinned to a bound. One unclamped reading proves nothing about the next - exactly as one healthy book sample proves nothing under L-005.

event_c_bnb_4h_bar.finding: THE BAR DID NOT AGE OUT AND THE PRINT IS UNREVISED - its wick/body ratio is UNCHANGED at 16.0. The 4h scan went clean because the MEDIAN RANGE OF THE WINDOW ROSE, pushing the bar's range multiple below the rm>=2 gate. A scan went clean because the DENOMINATOR moved: not the market, not the print, not the calendar. Purest L-006 instance of the experiment and the FOURTH distinct mechanism in four checks to move a BNB reading while 780.90 stands (after ageing out of the 1h window, being EXCEEDED by a genuine 783.34 print, and a 24h window roll).
event_c_bnb_4h_bar.verdict: BNBUSDT is NOT clean at every resolution and STAYS EXCLUDED.

findings: ETHUSDT FAILED ON BOTH CROSSED SIDES WITHIN ONE CHECK - a new form. Ask 1,163.52 USDT at s1 (the side a long entry must cross, 2.1x too small) and bid 449.23 USDT at s5 (the side a short sells into and a long exits into, 5.6x too small), with four healthy samples in between.

THE 449.23 USDT ETH BID QUOTED 0.037 bps - THE TIGHTEST SPREAD OF THE CHECK. The cleanest single illustration this experiment has produced of the lesson's core claim that the spread cap measures price and is blind to quantity.
SOLUSDT's ask printed 5.81 USDT at s2 - the smallest print of the check - WHILE QUOTING 3.445 bps, and 338.20 USDT at s3.
XRPUSDT's bid printed 47.49 USDT at s4 - a SIXTH CONSECUTIVE CHECK with an XRP bid collapse.

RECORDED AGAINST INTEREST, AND A FIRST FOR EITHER: BTCUSDT held above one maximum order on BOTH sides at ALL FIVE sweeps (worst 8,557.65 ask at s4), and BNBUSDT did the same (worst 9,118.43 bid at s1). Two of five held a quoted book across five sweeps - against 23:00, when all five failed simultaneously at s5. Both are excluded under L-001 so it changes nothing, but a lesson's evidence must include the samples that do not fit it.

The 25 bps cap fired ZERO times and every failure above sat INSIDE the 12.053 bps widest spread. A reduce-only stop resting on this book between checks still cannot be assumed to fill near its trigger - P-009.
